Messages.Author: Grey Wanderer
Messages.Body:
What happens to werewolves like High Top, Cry Wolf, Samuel Haight,
Ossian and Harzomatuili when Abomination is played on them? Will they
retain the special abilities they had before they were turned into
Abominations? Or will they lose them once they become Abominations,
and just have the abilities on the Abomination card?

Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:
Hmm not sure I understand. The Abomination card clearly states that you
burn the ally. So they have no way of retaining anything.

So unless I completely misunderstand your question they just have the
abililities on the Abomination card.
